categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies compact block message construction and relay logic in src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Caches serialized compact block messages across announcements and getdata responses to avoid redundant serialization and prepare for compact block prefilling in PR 35558. The author notes that on its own this change has little impact on block propagation, making it an internal optimization and preparatory refactor for upcoming relay work.
